'''MSE-X-PR6''' was a modified [[Rebaxan Columni/Legends|Rebaxan Columni]] [[MSE-6 series repair droid/Legends|MSE-6]] droid assigned to the [[Imperial Research Station (Binaros)|research station]] on [[Binaros]]. The little droid used to be a standard MSE-6 droid, but, due to his assignment as a messenger between the station personnel, his skill matrix was removed, and a [[Vocabulator/Legends|vocabulator]] unit was installed. His [[Holocamera/Legends|holocam]] and manipulator arm were also removed to give him a storage space for carrying [[Datapad/Legends|datapads]].

However, a glitch in MSE-X-PR6's programming led him to engage in petty thievery, swiping interesting objects and keeping them hidden in the storeroom in the facility. His two most prized items were a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]], and a piece of [[DarkStryder technology]].

MSE-X-PR6 was left behind when the station was abandoned. When the crew of the ''[[FarStar]]'' arrived, he offered his services as a messenger since he was lonely and bored, and wanted to leave the facility. He was even prepared to threaten them with the thermal detonator, or to trade the DarkStryder object for passage.

==Behind the scenes==
An alternative adventure strand for MSE-X-PR6 involves using the droid as an assassin droid or a saboteur to incapacitate the ''[[FarStar]]'' at the worst possible moment.
